items.markdown:
To qualify for a Thailand retirement visa, `you must be at least 50 years old and meet specific financial and health criteria` . The main options include the standard Non-Immigrant O/O-A single or multi-year visas, the 5-to-10 year O-X visa, or the 10-year Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa. You can submit applications through the official [Thai E-Visa Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) or via local immigration offices if applying from within the country.[](https://www.banyangroupresidences.com/news/thailand-retirement-visa-guide) [[1]](https://www.banyangroupresidences.com/news/thailand-retirement-visa-guide)[[2]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa-types)[[3]](https://wise.com/gb/blog/thai-retirement-visa)

Age and General Criteria

- **Age limit:** Must be 50 years or older on the application date.
- **Passport:** Valid for at least 12 months (or 6 months depending on the specific in-country extension path).
- **Criminal record:** Clean background check/police clearance certificate from your home country.
- **Medical check:** Medical certificate confirming no prohibited diseases (e.g., leprosy, tuberculosis, advanced syphilis).[](https://pretoria.thaiembassy.org/en/page/non-immigrant-o-a-long-stay-retirement-visa?menu=62abc189ae139c5de3288c32) [[1]](https://pretoria.thaiembassy.org/en/page/non-immigrant-o-a-long-stay-retirement-visa?menu=62abc189ae139c5de3288c32)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/living-in-thailand)[[3]](https://thailandelitevisa.com/thailand-retirement-visa-complete-guide/)

Financial Requirements (Standard O and O-A Visas)You must choose one of these three financial pathways:[](https://thailandelitevisa.com/thailand-retirement-visa-complete-guide/) 

- **Bank deposit method:** Keep at least 800,000 THB (~$22,000 USD / £18,000) in a Thai bank account for the required seasoning period (typically 2 to 3 months prior to applying).
- **Monthly income method:** Show a stable monthly pension or income of at least 65,000 THB (~$1,800 USD / £1,500).
- **Combination method:** Mix annual income and bank deposits to total 800,000 THB per year.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/retirement-visa) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/retirement-visa)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/retirement-visa)

Health Insurance Rules

- **Mandatory coverage:** Required for long-stay O-A and O-X applicants applying from abroad.
- **Minimum limits:** Inpatient coverage of at least 400,000 THB and outpatient coverage of at least 40,000 THB.[](https://www.banyangroupresidences.com/news/thailand-retirement-visa-guide) 

Ongoing Responsibilities

- **90-day reporting:** Notify the Thai Immigration Bureau of your current residential address every 90 days.
- **Re-entry permits:** Obtain a re-entry permit before leaving Thailand if you plan to return without canceling your current visa stay.
- **Employment restriction:** Working is strictly prohibited on standard retirement visas.
